en.name: Voice assistant
en.permission: Microphone audio is streamed securely to Gemini only while voice mode is on. The app does not save recordings.
en.unsupported: Live voice is not supported in this browser. Use text input or try the latest Chrome or Edge.
en.help: Try: “register a new patient”, “book an appointment”, “show my record”, “explain oral cancer symptoms”, “change language to Telugu”, or “read this page aloud”.

en.denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in browser settings or use the text command box.

en.audioError: The browser could not use the microphone. Check that the selected microphone is connected and not being used exclusively by another app.

en.repeat: There is no response to repeat yet.
en.openedRegister: The patient registration form is open. Required fields such as email and password must be entered manually. I will not speak or collect passwords.

en.askVillage: Please say the village or town.
en.confirmValue: I heard this value. Confirm to put it in the form, or cancel and try again.
en.savedName: Name added to the form. Please say the patient ID.
en.savedId: Patient ID added to the form. Please say the village or town.
en.allFields: The required fields are filled. Review them and press Save yourself when ready. I have not submitted the form.
en.cancelField: I cancelled the voice entry. You can edit the form manually.
en.permissionRequired: This action is not available for your account role. Please use an authorized care-team account.
en.loginFirst: Please sign in first. I will not open private patient information without an authenticated account.

en.patientRecord: I opened your account’s patient dashboard. I will not read private patient details aloud.

en.security: Privacy: voice commands do not execute code. Do not speak private details in public.
